concepts.title: 对数方程与真数限制
concepts.summary: $\log_b L=\log_b R$ 仅在 $b>0,b\ne1,L>0,R>0$ 时等价于 $L=R$。先列原式定义域，再运算法则，最后代回。

method.title: 列限制
method.body: 原式每个对数真数均须严格为正。

method.title: 解并验根
method.body: 合并对数或化指数式，解代数式，再排除原式无定义的候选值。

pitfalls: 不要把 $\log(u^2)$ 写成 $2\log u$ 后丢失 $u<0$ 的解。

en.title: Logarithmic equations and restrictions
en.summary: $\log_b L=\log_b R$ is equivalent to $L=R$ when $b>0,b\ne1,L>0,R>0$. Record the original domain, apply laws, then substitute back.

method.title: State restrictions
method.body: Every original logarithm must have a strictly positive argument.

method.title: Solve and check
method.body: Combine logs or exponentiate, solve the algebraic equation and reject undefined candidates.

pitfalls: Rewriting $\log(u^2)$ as $2\log u$ can lose solutions with $u<0$.

concepts.title: 用对数解指数方程
concepts.summary: 对正数两边取相同合法底数的对数；用 $\log(a^t)=t\log a$ 把未知指数变成一次式。

method.title: 隔离指数项
method.body: 先除去指数项外的乘数，再取对数。

method.title: 保留精确式
method.body: 先求含对数的精确值，最后按要求舍入并核对。

en.title: Solve exponential equations using logarithms
en.summary: Take logarithms with the same valid base on both positive sides. The power law $\log(a^t)=t\log a$ turns an unknown exponent into a linear expression.

method.title: Isolate the exponential
method.body: Divide out any multiplier before taking logarithms.

method.title: Keep exact values
method.body: Keep an exact logarithmic expression until final rounding and verification.

concepts.title: 增长、衰减与科学模型
concepts.summary: $Q=Q_0b^{t/d}$，$Q_0>0,b>0,b\ne1$。倍增取 $b=2$，半衰取 $b=1/2$；时间单位必须一致。

method.title: 建立比值
method.body: 除以初始量，取对数求时间或周期。

method.title: 解释
method.body: 检验正量、实际时间与单位，近似值注明精度。

en.title: Growth, decay and scientific models
en.summary: $Q=Q_0b^{t/d}$, where $Q_0>0,b>0,b\ne1$. Use $b=2$ for doubling and $b=1/2$ for half-life; time units must agree.

method.title: Form a ratio
method.body: Divide by the initial quantity, then take logs to find time or period.

method.title: Interpret
method.body: Check positivity, practical time and units; state approximation precision.

method.title: 换算每期
method.body: 半年复利用年利率除以2；日复利用365天约定。

method.title: 求期数
method.body: 取对数求 $n$，再换成年；离散支付须检查完整付款次数。

en.title: Compound interest and equal payments
en.summary: $A=P(1+i)^n$ and $PV=R[1-(1+i)^{-n}]/i$. Here $i$ is the rate per period and $n$ the number of periods.

method.title: Convert the rate
method.body: Divide APR by 2 for semi-annual compounding; use a 365-day year for daily compounding.

method.title: Find periods
method.body: Use logarithms to solve for $n$, then convert to years; check complete discrete payments.

concepts.title: 结构、数列与三角联结
concepts.summary: 换底使同一未知量的不同底对数可合并；复合对数、数列和三角方程还须保留各自定义域。

method.title: 选合适变量
method.body: 令 $u=\log x$ 或 $s=\sin x$，并记录限制。

method.title: 返回原变量
method.body: 解辅助方程后检查原式、区间及整数条件。

en.title: Structure, sequences and trigonometric connections
en.summary: Change of base combines logs with different bases. Composite logarithms, sequences and trig equations retain their own domain restrictions.

method.title: Choose a variable
method.body: Set $u=\log x$ or $s=\sin x$ and record restrictions.

method.title: Return to the original
method.body: Check the original equation, interval and integer conditions after solving the auxiliary equation.

questions.prompt: (growth) 想一想生活中体现指数增长的情境。电脑有1 TB，即1 048 576 MB。第1天储存1 MB，此后每天新增数据为前一天的两倍。(prediction) 预测何日空间不足。(notice) 你会在哪一天意识到空间不足？(extra-storage) 若再买15 TB，能继续倍增多久？

steps.title: 生活中的增长示例
steps.body: 例如在固定正利率下不提款的复利储蓄，每期余额乘以相同的因子。若初始1000元、每年利率5%，则 $A(t)=1000(1.05)^t$；第0、1、2年为1000、1050、1102.50元。此为说明模型的示例，不是个人账户数据。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 意识到不足属开放判断；例如第19天已用约50%，第20天已用99.9999%，应在此之前安排扩容。总容量16 TB $=2^{24}$ MB，可容纳至第24天的 $2^{24}-1$ MB，第25天不足；比原来多4个完整日。

questions.answer: 指数增长示例：固定正利率下的复利储蓄。第21天不足；觉察日期为合理个人判断；加15 TB后第25天不足，多4天。

en.prompt: (growth) Think of situations in your life that show exponential growth. A computer has 1 TB = 1 048 576 MB. Store 1 MB on day 1 and twice the previous day’s amount on each successive day. (prediction) Predict when space runs out. (notice) On what day will you realise you are running out? (extra-storage) With an additional 15 TB, how long can doubling continue?

steps.title: A growth example
steps.body: One example is compound-interest savings with a fixed positive rate and no withdrawals: each period multiplies the balance by the same factor. With an initial 1000 dollars at 5% yearly, $A(t)=1000(1.05)^t$, giving 1000, 1050, and 1102.50 dollars at years 0, 1, and 2. This illustrates a model, rather than personal account data.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Day $n$ adds $2^{n-1}$ MB; total use is $S_n=2^n-1$ MB. $S_{20}=1\,048\,575$ leaves 1 MB. The addition of 1 048 576 MB on day 21 does not fit.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Awareness is an open judgement: day 19 is about 50% full and day 20 is 99.9999% full, so expansion should be arranged before then. With 16 TB $=2^{24}$ MB total, $2^{24}-1$ MB fits through day 24, but day 25 fails: four additional complete days.

en.answer: A growth example is compound-interest savings at a fixed positive rate. Space fails on day 21; awareness is an open judgement. Adding 15 TB delays failure to day 25, four extra days.
en.label: Opening: computer disk space

questions.prompt: 对 $2\log x=\log36$：(a) 对左边用对数法则；(b) 描述如何解新方程；(c) 求新方程的两个 $x$ 值。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 原式要求 $x>0$。幂法则给 $\log(x^2)=\log36$。(b) 同底对数相等给 $x^2=36$。(c) 新方程有 $x=\pm6$；其中负值需回原式检查。

en.prompt: For $2\log x=\log36$: (a) apply a logarithm law to the left side; (b) describe how to solve the resulting equation; (c) find two values satisfying that rewritten equation.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) The original requires $x>0$; the power law gives $\log(x^2)=\log36$. (b) Equate arguments to get $x^2=36$. (c) The rewritten equation has $x=\pm6$; the negative candidate must be checked in the original.

en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 探究1

questions.prompt: (a) 描述图解原方程 $2\log x=\log36$ 的方法。(b) 用此方法求解。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 绘 $y=2\log x$（仅 $x>0$）和水平线 $y=\log36\approx1.5563$。(b) 交点为 $(6,1.5563\ldots)$，横坐标给 $x=6$；没有负半轴上的原图。

en.prompt: (a) Describe how to solve the original $2\log x=\log36$ graphically. (b) Use the method to solve it.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Plot $y=2\log x$ for $x>0$ and the horizontal line $y=\log36\approx1.5563$. (b) Their intersection is $(6,1.5563\ldots)$, so $x=6$; the original log curve has no negative-$x$ branch.

en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 探究2

questions.prompt: 哪些 $x$ 值满足原方程 $2\log x=\log36$？解释。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: $x=6>0$ 且 $2\log6=\log36$。$x=-6$ 使 $\log x$ 无实数值，故排除。

en.prompt: Which values satisfy the original $2\log x=\log36$? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $x=6>0$ and $2\log6=\log36$. At $x=-6$, $\log x$ has no real value, so reject it.

en.label: Reflect and Respond 3

questions.label: 反思3

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: Adam依次除以2、把25和125改写为5的幂、用幂的乘方法则、同底指数函数单射性比较指数，解 $2x+2=3$ 得 $x=1/2$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: Sarah依次除以2、对正数两边取常用对数、用幂法则、展开并隔离 $x$。分子 $\log125-\log25=\log5$，分母 $\log25=2\log5\ne0$，所以 $x=1/2$。代回 $2(25^{3/2})=250$。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Adam divides by 2, rewrites 25 and 125 as powers of 5, applies power of a power, then equates exponents by injectivity. Solving $2x+2=3$ gives $x=1/2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Sarah divides by 2, takes common logs of positive sides, applies the power law and isolates $x$. The numerator is $\log5$ and denominator $2\log5\ne0$, giving $x=1/2$. Substitution gives $2(25^{3/2})=250$.

questions.prompt: 给出Adam第4步和Sarah第4步的另一个完成方法。

en.prompt: Give another way to complete step 4 of Adam’s work and step 4 of Sarah’s work.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Adam can take $\log_5$ of $5^{2(x+1)}=5^3$ to obtain $2(x+1)=3$, hence $x=3/2-1=1/2$. Sarah can divide directly by $\log25$: $x+1=\log125/\log25=3/2$, hence $x=1/2$.

en.answer: Both alternatives obtain $3/2$ and then subtract 1.

questions.label: 探究5

questions.prompt: 你更喜欢哪人的方法？解释。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 示例选择Adam法：25和125都是5的幂，$2(x+1)=3$ 很短且得精确值。也可合理选择Sarah法，因为它适用于更多底数组合。

questions.answer: 开放选择；理由需对应实际方法。

en.prompt: Which person’s method do you prefer? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: A sample preference is Adam’s method: 25 and 125 are powers of 5, so $2(x+1)=3$ is short and exact. Sarah’s method is also a reasonable preference because it works for more base combinations.

en.answer: Open choice with a reason tied to the methods.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 6

questions.label: 反思6

questions.prompt: 什么指数方程能用Adam法？什么方程需要Sarah法？解释。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 若各底数可方便表示为同一合法底数的幂，如 $4^x=8$，可得 $2x=3$。若不能方便写为共同底数，如 $2^x=7$，用对数得 $x=\log7/\log2$。这里“需要”指教材的代数方法选择，并非排除图解法。

questions.answer: 共同幂底数用Adam；一般正底指数方程可用Sarah。

en.prompt: What exponential equations can be solved with Adam’s method, and what equations need Sarah’s method? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: When bases can conveniently be written as powers of one valid common base, such as $4^x=8$, equate exponents: $2x=3$. For $2^x=7$, no convenient common-power representation is available, so logs give $x=\log7/\log2$. This comparison concerns the textbook’s algebraic methods; graphing is another option.

en.answer: Use Adam’s approach for common-power bases; Sarah’s applies to general positive-base exponential equations.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 7

questions.label: 反思7

questions.prompt: Sarah第2步能改用别的底数的对数吗？说明。

en.prompt: Could Sarah use logarithms to another base in step 2? Justify.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Yes. For any $b>0,b\ne1$, $(x+1)\log_b25=\log_b125$. Change of base gives $\log_b125/\log_b25=\log125/\log25=3/2$, so $x=1/2$.

questions.label: 反思8

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) $x>1/2$。$2x-1=11\Rightarrow x=6$；原真数为11，与右边相同。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 只需 $x\ne-3$。$(x+3)^2=2^4=16\Rightarrow x+3=\pm4$，所以 $x=1,-7$；代回真数均为16，对数均为4。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x>1/2$. Equate arguments: $2x-1=11\Rightarrow x=6$. The original argument is 11, matching the right side.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) The original domain is $x>-1/2$. Combining gives $\log[(8x+4)/(x+1)]=1$, so $8x+4=10(x+1)$ and candidate $x=-3$. Both original arguments are negative there; no solution.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Require only $x\ne-3$. $(x+3)^2=16$ gives $x+3=\pm4$, so $x=1,-7$. Both produce argument 16 and logarithm 4.

questions.prompt: (a) 如何用 $y=\log_6(2x-1)-\log_6 11$ 的图求解？(b) 为什么负数的实对数无定义？(c) 若在例题1(c)使用幂法则，会怎样影响解？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 求差函数的 $x$ 截距；$2x-1=11$ 给 $(6,0)$。(b) 合法正底 $b$ 的任何实数幂 $b^t$ 都大于0，因此不可能等于负数。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 直接写 $2\log_2(x+3)=4$ 会强加 $x>-3$ 而漏掉 $x=-7$。完整等价式应为 $2\log_2|x+3|=4$，得 $|x+3|=4$，保留两解。

questions.answer: (a) $x$截距6；(b) 正底实幂恒正；(c) 需绝对值以保留 $-7$。

en.prompt: (a) How could the graph of $y=\log_6(2x-1)-\log_6 11$ solve the equation? (b) Why is a real logarithm of a negative number undefined? (c) What happens if the power law is used in Example 1(c)?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Find the $x$-intercept of the difference function: $2x-1=11$ gives $(6,0)$. (b) Every real power $b^t$ of a valid positive base is positive, so it cannot equal a negative number.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Writing $2\log_2(x+3)=4$ adds $x>-3$ and loses $x=-7$. The full equivalent is $2\log_2|x+3|=4$, giving $|x+3|=4$ and both solutions.

en.answer: (a) $x$-intercept 6; (b) positive-base real powers are positive; (c) absolute values preserve $-7$.

questions.label: 例题1旁注

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) $x>0$；$4x=12\Rightarrow x=3$，原式 $\log_7 12=\log_7 12$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (b) $x>6$；$(x-6)(x-4)=8\Rightarrow x^2-10x+16=0\Rightarrow x=2,8$。仅8合法；原式 $\log_2 2=3-\log_2 4=1$。

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x>0$; $4x=12$ gives $x=3$, and both sides equal $\log_7 12$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $x>6$; $(x-6)(x-4)=8$ gives $x^2-10x+16=0$ and candidates 2,8. Only 8 is valid; $\log_2 2=3-\log_2 4=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Positivity of the fifth power requires $x^2-8x>0$, so $x<0$ or $x>8$. From $(x^2-8x)^5=3^{10}$ obtain $x^2-8x=9$, so $(x-9)(x+1)=0$. Both $-1,9$ produce original argument $9^5=3^{10}$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) $x\log4=\log605$，所以 $x=\log605/\log4\approx4.62$。精确式代入给 $4^x=605$。

en.prompt: Solve, rounding to two decimal places: (a) $4^x=605$; (b) $8(3^{2x})=568$; (c) $4^{2x-1}=3^{x+2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x\log4=\log605$, so $x=\log605/\log4\approx4.62$. The exact expression gives $4^x=605$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $3^{2x}=71$; $2x\log3=\log71$ gives $x=\log71/(2\log3)\approx1.94$. Substitution yields $8\cdot71=568$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) $(2x-1)\log4=(x+2)\log3$, hence $x(2\log4-\log3)=\log4+2\log3$. Thus $x=(\log4+2\log3)/(2\log4-\log3)\approx2.14$. The nonzero denominator $\log(16/3)>0$ ensures uniqueness.

en.label: Example 2

questions.prompt: (a) 对例题2(a)，你更喜欢取对数还是改写对数形式？(b) 为什么 $8(3^{2x})$ 不能写成 $24^{2x}$？(c) 解释例题2(b)步骤并给出另一种对数解法。(d) 还可怎样核验例题2(c)？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (a) 示例选择 $x=\log_4 605$，直接表达未知指数；共同对数法也有效。(b) $24^{2x}=8^{2x}3^{2x}$，8也被乘方，原式的8未被乘方；如 $x=0$，两式分别为8与1。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: (c) 先除以8得 $3^{2x}=71$，取对数并除以 $2\log3$。另一法为 $2x=\log_3 71$，再除以2。(d) 绘两条正指数曲线 $y=4^{2x-1}$ 和 $y=3^{x+2}$，交点横坐标约2.14；也可代入未舍入的精确式比两边。

questions.answer: 偏好开放；不能对乘数错误使用幂法则；另用换底或图解核验。

en.prompt: (a) For Example 2(a), which logarithm method do you prefer? (b) Why cannot $8(3^{2x})$ be written as $24^{2x}$? (c) Explain Example 2(b) and give another logarithm approach. (d) Give another way to verify Example 2(c).

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) A sample preference is $x=\log_4 605$, which directly names the unknown exponent; common logs also work. (b) $24^{2x}=8^{2x}3^{2x}$ raises 8 to a power, unlike the original. At $x=0$, the expressions are 8 and 1.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) Divide by 8 to obtain $3^{2x}=71$, take logs and divide by $2\log3$. Alternatively, write $2x=\log_3 71$ and divide by 2. (d) Graph $y=4^{2x-1}$ and $y=3^{x+2}$: their intersection has $x\approx2.14$. Substituting the unrounded exact value is another check.

en.answer: Preference is open; do not apply an exponent to an outside multiplier. Change of base or graphing gives alternative checks.

questions.prompt: 肉食恐龙头骨长 $s$ 米与体重 $m$ 千克满足 $3.6022\log s=\log m-3.4444$。Albertosaurus头骨长0.78 m，求体重，精确至千克。

steps.body: $\log s=(\log5500-3.4444)/3.6022$, hence $s=10^{(\log5500-3.4444)/3.6022}\approx1.21$ m. It is positive and satisfies the model.

questions.prompt: 碳14半衰期5730年。Head-Smashed-In Buffalo Jump最古老的骨头剩49.5%的碳14，发现时这些骨头多老？

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 取对数：$t=5730\log0.495/\log0.5\approx5813.08$ 年。比例略小于一半，年龄略大于5730年，合理。

en.prompt: Carbon-14 has half-life 5730 years. The oldest bones at Head-Smashed-In Buffalo Jump retained 49.5% of their carbon-14. How old were they when found?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let age $t\ge0$ years. $0.495m_0=m_0(1/2)^{t/5730}$; cancelling positive $m_0$ gives $0.495=(1/2)^{t/5730}$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Taking logs gives $t=5730\log0.495/\log0.5\approx5813.08$ years. The fraction is slightly below one half, so an age slightly above 5730 years is reasonable.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $0.495=(0.5)^{t/5730}$ is equivalent to $\log_{0.5}0.495=t/5730$, so $t=5730\log_{0.5}0.495\approx5813$ years. This approach directly isolates the exponent; common logs may be preferred for a basic calculator.

en.answer: Age is still about 5813 years; preference is open.

questions.prompt: 倍增模型 $N(t)=N_0 2^{t/d}$。某培养物最初1000个E. coli，90 min后19 500个。求倍增周期 $d$，精确至分钟。

en.prompt: The doubling model is $N(t)=N_0 2^{t/d}$. A culture initially has 1000 E. coli and has 19 500 after 90 min. Find its doubling period $d$, to the nearest minute.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $19\,500=1000\cdot2^{90/d}$, so $19.5=2^{90/d}$. Then $\log19.5=(90/d)\log2$, giving $d=90\log2/\log19.5\approx21.00$ min. The positive unrounded period reproduces 19 500.

exercises.prompt: 原无北方狗鱼的湖被投放鱼苗，$t$ 年后数量 $P=10\,000(1.035)^t$。(a) 初投多少条？(b) 年增长率多少？(c) 倍增需多久？

en.prompt: A previously pike-free lake is stocked. After $t$ years its northern pike population is $P=10\,000(1.035)^t$. (a) How many were stocked? (b) What is the annual percentage growth rate? (c) How long until the population doubles?

steps.title: Calculate and check

en.prompt: Kepler’s third law is $\log T=\frac32\log d-3.263$, where $T$ is in Earth years and $d$ in millions of kilometres. (a) Pluto averages 5906 million km from the Sun: find its period to the nearest year. (b) Mars has period 1.88 Earth years: find its distance to the nearest million kilometres.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $T=10^{1.5\log5906-3.263}\approx247.71$, hence 248 Earth years. (b) $\log d=(\log1.88+3.263)/1.5$ gives $d\approx228.09$ million km, rounding to 228 million km. Both quantities are positive.

en.prompt: Use $A=P(1+i)^n$, with rate $i$ per period and $n$ periods; all stated rates are APR. (a) David invests 10 000 dollars at 6% compounded semi-annually. How long to reach 11 000 dollars? steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $i=0.03$; $n=\log1.1/\log1.03\approx3.2244$ half-years, or 1.6122 years by exponential interpolation. At semi-annual credit dates, the first balance at least 11 000 dollars occurs after 4 periods, 2 years.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Using a 365-day year, $i=0.28/365$. $n=\log(1241.18/1200)/\log(1+0.28/365)\approx44.00$ days; the day-44 balance rounds to 1241.18 dollars.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) $i=0.0275$; $n=\log3/\log1.0275\approx40.4964$ periods, or 20.2482 years by interpolation. The first semi-annual credit date reaching triple is period 41, or 20.5 years.

en.answer: (a)Model 1.61 years; first credit date 2 years. (b)44 days. (c)Model 20.25 years; first credit date 20.5 years.

en.prompt: A mortgage has present value 250 000 dollars, APR 7.4%, and semi-annual end-of-period payments of 10 429.01 dollars. Use $PV=R[1-(1+i)^{-n}]/i$, where $n$ is the number of payments and $i$ the periodic rate. After how many years is it paid off?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $n=-\log[1-250000(0.037)/10429.01]/\log1.037\approx60.00001$. The payment is rounded to cents, so this represents 60 semi-annual payments, about 30 years; the final payment may need a cents adjustment rather than an extra full period.

exercises.prompt: 瑞典云杉根剩31.5%的碳14，半衰期5730年。发现时树龄是多少？

en.prompt: A Swedish spruce’s roots retain 31.5% of their carbon-14. With half-life 5730 years, how old was the tree when discovered?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $0.315=(1/2)^{t/5730}$ gives $t=5730\log0.315/\log0.5\approx9549.48$ years. This positive time lies between one and two half-lives, consistent with the fraction lying between 1/4 and 1/2.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Let half-life be $h$ hours. $274/280=(1/2)^{6/h}$ gives $h=6\log0.5/\log(274/280)\approx191.9943$ h. Dividing by 24 gives about 8.00 days, rounding to 8 days.

en.prompt: If $\log_3 81=x-y$ and $\log_2 32=x+y$, find $x,y$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $\log_3 81=4$ and $\log_2 32=5$. Adding gives $2x=9$, so $x=9/2$; subtracting gives $2y=1$, so $y=1/2$. Their difference is 4 and sum 5.

steps.body: (b) $\log(1/5)<0$，除以它时不等号必须反向，应得 $1<2$。此前取常用对数和幂法则均正确。

en.prompt: Solve: (a) $x^{2/\log x}=x$; (b) $\log(x^{\log x})=4$; (c) $(\log x)^2=\log(x^2)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x>0,x\ne1$. Taking logs gives $(2/\log x)\log x=\log x$, so $\log x=2$ and $x=100$. The exponent becomes 1, verifying it.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) $x>0$. The power law gives $(\log x)^2=4$, so $\log x=\pm2$ and $x=100,0.01$. Each gives $x^{\log x}=10^4$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (c) The original requires $x>0$. Set $u=\log x$: $u^2=2u$ gives $u(u-2)=0$, hence $x=1,100$. Original sides are respectively 0 and 4.

en.prompt: Solve: (a) $\log_4x+\log_2x=6$; (b) $\log_3x-\log_{27}x=4/3$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $x>0$. Set $u=\log_2x$, so $\log_4x=u/2$. Then $u/2+u=6$ gives $u=4$, hence $x=16$. Check $2+4=6$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Set $v=\log_3x$, so $\log_{27}x=v/3$. Then $v-v/3=4/3$ gives $v=2$ and $x=9$. Check $2-2/3=4/3$.

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 零底不能产生1。若考虑个别可定义的负底实数幂，要使值为1，必须底数为−1且指数为合适的偶整数或最简分数中偶分子、奇分母的有理数。$B=-1$ 得 $x=(-3\pm\sqrt{41})/2$，指数 $2x-8=-11\pm\sqrt{41}$ 为无理数，负底实幂无定义。因此没有额外实解。

en.prompt: Find all values satisfying $(x^2+3x-9)^{2x-8}=1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: First consider positive base $B=x^2+3x-9>0$. If $B=1$, $(x+5)(x-2)=0$ gives $x=-5,2$. If $B\ne1$, logs give $(2x-8)\log B=0$, hence $x=4$, whose base is 19.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Zero base cannot produce 1. For individually defined negative-base real powers to equal 1, the base must be −1 and the exponent a suitable even integer or rational in lowest terms with even numerator and odd denominator. $B=-1$ gives $x=(-3\pm\sqrt{41})/2$, with irrational exponents $-11\pm\sqrt{41}$, so these negative-base powers are not real. There are no additional real solutions.

en.prompt: Fatima starts with $8(2^x)=512$, then $\log[8(2^x)]=\log512$ and $\log8+\log2^x=\log512$. (a) Complete her solution. (b) Suggest and compare another approach. (c) State and explain a preference.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) $\log8+x\log2=\log512$, so $x=\log64/\log2=6$. Check $8\cdot64=512$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Divide by 8: $2^x=64=2^6$, hence $x=6$. (c) A sample preference is the shorter exact common-base method; the log method is more general.

en.answer: $x=6$; both methods work and preference is open.

en.prompt: The geometric general term is $t_n=t_1r^{n-1}$. How many terms are in $4,12,36,\ldots,708\,588$?
The first $n$ terms of $8192+4096+2048+\cdots$ sum to 16 383. Use $S_n=t_1(r^n-1)/(r-1)$, $r\ne1$, to find $n$.
Solve for $0\le x\le2\pi$: (a) $2\log_2(\cos x)+1=0$; (b) $\log(\sin x)+\log(2\sin x-1)=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (a) Require $\cos x>0$. $\log_2\cos x=-1/2$ gives $\cos x=\sqrt2/2$, so $x=\pi/4,7\pi/4$. Each yields $2(-1/2)+1=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: (b) Require $\sin x>1/2$. Let $s=\sin x$. Then $s(2s-1)=1$ gives $(2s+1)(s-1)=0$. Reject −1/2; $s=1$ gives $x=\pi/2$. Both original arguments are 1.
